messages:
Harper Nguyen: Quick request — we're drafting a super-compact "renewal rapid triage" tech probe to send to 3 at-risk accounts. Goal: a single-screen checklist their engs can fill + 3 runnable checks (cache smell, batch perf, streaming), plus a tiny telemetry primer (Grafana/PromQL snippets) so AMs can ask for exact charts before the call. Keep it skimmable.

Diego Ortiz: Love it. Make it a form + short "run these 3 commands" section. Add a small field where they paste a config-fingerprint (sha256 of their runtime config) so our SRE can match what they ran.

Nina Rao: For thresholds: cache_hit < 30% = candidate for prefix caching; p95 > 450ms = ops review; cold_start_rate > 5% = warm pool recommended. Also capture kv_warm_rate (how often prefix cache warms).

Harper Nguyen: Nice. Can we include quick PromQL examples for AMs to request from the customer (or for the customer to paste graphs)? Many AMs ask for vague "cache charts" and get back screenshots. Let's include exact queries.

ops_assistant: Tip: run `/prefill-metrics <acct>` to auto-add cache_hit and p95 into the form. I can also create a ticket automatically when the form is returned.

Caleb Morris: Draft PromQL snippets — keep them simple: 
- Cache hit (7d): sum(rate(cache_hits_total[7d])) / sum(rate(cache_requests_total[7d])) * 100
- p95 latency (24h): histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[24h])) by (le))
- Cold starts (24h): sum(rate(cold_start_total[24h])) / sum(rate(requests_total[24h])) * 100
Include copy-paste links to Grafana panels where possible.

Nina Rao: Add one-line 'what to change now' recommendations next to each failing metric: e.g., cache_hit low -> enable prefix cache + increase TTL; p95 high -> reduce batch_size for interactive flows; cold_start high -> enable warm-pools / pre-warm.

Harper Nguyen: Also include a tiny reproducible streaming smoke test and a config snippet they can paste back to us (so SRE can reproduce). Make the curl example use streaming header and show how to verify chunked responses.

Caleb Morris: Streaming smoke test: 
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Prefer: streaming=1" \
  -d '{"input":"health-check","stream":true}' https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate | sed -n '1,5p'
```
Minimal config to paste back: 
```
{"cache_prefix":"org-456","cache_ttl_secs":3600,"batch_size":4,"enable_streaming":true}
```
And ask them to paste config-fingerprint (sha256) of the JSON above so we know exactly what was used.

Diego Ortiz: Good. For the cache smell test, include this quick header check: 
```
curl -I -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate | grep -i \"x-cache\" -i
```
If headers show MISS often, suggest prefix caching or shared-KV.

Nina Rao: Let's include an AM-facing one-line mapping of signals -> recommended AM action: 
- low cache_hit (<30%) -> Ask eng to enable prefix caching & increase TTL; schedule 30m tuning call.
- p95 regressions (>450ms) -> Ops deep-dive + check batch_size/concurrency; consider canary to a faster model.
- rising cold_start_rate (>5%) -> Recommend warm-pools & increase minimum capacity; open SRE ticket.
- billing disputes / usage variance -> Finance + usage audit; request tokenized sample traces.

Harper Nguyen: Pasteable customer form (one-line items so AMs can paste into email):
---
RENEWAL RAPID TRIAGE (please complete before the call)
- Account name:
- Eng contact (name / email):
- Affected endpoint(s) / routes:
- Cache approach (prefix / response / shared KV):
- Cache TTLs observed (s):
- Cache hit % (7d):
- kv_warm_rate (if available):
- batch_size (min / max):
- streaming enabled? (y / n):
- p95 latency (24h):
- cold_start_rate (24h):
- Error rate (24h):
- Config-fingerprint (sha256 of runtime config JSON):
- Recent config changes (14d):
- Top 3 flows to test:
---

Caleb Morris: Also paste the PromQL snippets block so AMs can ask customers to share exact queries or screenshots: 
```
# Cache hit (7d)
sum(rate(cache_hits_total[7d])) / sum(rate(cache_requests_total[7d])) * 100
# p95 latency (24h)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[24h])) by (le))
# Cold start rate (24h)
sum(rate(cold_start_total[24h])) / sum(rate(requests_total[24h])) * 100
```

Harper Nguyen: ops_assistant — when returned forms arrive, can you create a ticket that includes the config-fingerprint as a searchable field? That will help SRE reproduce.

ops_assistant: Yes — use `/create-hotlist <acct> --fingerprint <sha256>` after uploading. I'll auto-populate the ticket with the PromQL snippets and the run commands. Ticket ID will be included in the reply.

Diego Ortiz: One more: include a tiny 'how we validate on our side' note so AMs know what to expect: we run the same curl tests, pull the 24h p95 and cache hit, compare to their supplied metrics, and attach a short ops summary to the renewal playbook.

Harper Nguyen: Great. Who can turn this into a one-page PDF + plain-text email snippet and add a short link to a tiny repo with node/python smoke tests and a small script to compute the config-fingerprint? Prefer this by EOD.

Caleb Morris: I'll assemble the PDF and push smoke tests + fingerprint script to the samples repo. Will post the draft here in ~3 hours.

Nina Rao: I'll review and add the AM action labels.

ops_assistant: Created ticket CS-RT-2019 assigned to Caleb Morris.

Harper Nguyen: Thanks team — this will reduce back-and-forth and let AMs triage renewal risk faster. :rocket:
